correctness.rationale: The radical V is characteristic and automorphisms are GLn. Pairwise witnesses force scalar preservation, homogeneity and projective-line injection; finite projective set makes it a permutation. Any dependent pair extends via a one-vector constraint; any independent pair via basis completion. Hence exactly (q−1)^N N! maps, a wreath product, and global rigidity iff n=1 or q=n=2. Direct verification enumerated small instances using original algebra GL witnesses. Computation only confirms finite instances; proof covers all q prime powers and n≥1.

value.rationale: The family K⊕V is the basic model of finite split square-zero local algebras. Exact classification of all two-local (not assumed additive) automorphisms gives an explicit group structure, a factorial finite-field invariant, and sharp global-rigidity threshold. The result answers a natural local-versus-global gap not settled by previously inspected local-linear examples; this is a complete natural family, not an arbitrary finite slice. Elementary proof is not itself a measure of trivial mathematical significance.
